content.title: Project Apex — Core Backend Payments & Multi-Currency Settlement Engine
content.summary: Expanded scope mutually agreed by Rohan (Acme Corp) and Mili Nair to add Real-Time UPI & FX Reconciliation.

features.name: Idempotent Double-Entry Ledger Core
features.description: ACID payment ledger handling 5,000 TPS without duplicate settlements.

features.name: Cryptographic Webhook Dispatcher
features.description: HMAC-signed merchant payout notifications with retry queues.

features.name: Real-Time UPI & Multi-Currency FX Reconciliation
features.description: Automated T+0 reconciliation across INR, USD, and SGD settlement accounts.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: Double-Entry Ledger & Settlement API
milestones.deliverables: Go ledger service, PostgreSQL migrations, benchmark suite

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Webhook Dispatcher & Production Cutover
milestones.deliverables: Webhook worker, Prometheus metrics, deployment guide

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Multi-Currency FX & UPI Reconciliation
milestones.deliverables: FX router service + automated T+0 reconciliation verifier

clauses.ipTransfer: Full intellectual property rights transfer to the Gig Provider upon milestone sign-off.
clauses.confidentiality: Both parties agree to keep proprietary source code and business data confidential.
clauses.governance: Blockchain Dual-Consent Lock: Once signed by both parties, neither party can alter time, cost, or features unilaterally. Any modification requires cryptographic approval from BOTH parties, minting a new Agreement version on-chain.

content.amendmentReason: Both parties agreed to add Milestone 3 (Multi-Currency UPI Reconciliation), extending timeline by 15 days and increasing compensation from ₹8,50,000 to ₹11,50,000.
